glue.reason: an Optimisation of #1499 (owner approval 2026-11-27): the scope check that mkTermToEvaluate makes of the applied term (`Eval.hs:129-130`, plutus 1.70.0.0) made once for a decoded program and kept with it, since the arguments are constants and the check visits the function before its argument; ScopeAppliedSuite and EvaluatorPathsSuite show it equal to the walk of the applied term. A program the node's cache hands to other threads has the check made first, so that no thread waits for another's
